records.failureSummary: Reviewed slice-foundation against the PRD, the API/architecture specs and the dependency QA report, inspecting src/config.js, src/store.js, src/atomic.js, src/password.js, src/keyring.js, src/logger.js, src/home.js, src/server.js, Dockerfile, .dockerignore, README.md, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and both test suites. Implementation evidence is solid: AC-04 is covered by 5 passing [AC-04] tests that write only into a mkdtemp DATA_DIR, persist db.json via temp-file+rename, store scrypt(salt 16B, N=16384,r=8,p=1) descriptors, survive a store reopen, and scan utf8/base64/hex variants to prove no plaintext password reaches disk; AC-21 is covered by a [AC-21] suite that boots the real server on an ephemeral port and asserts 200, text/html and all four data-testid elements (home-title, task-list, search-input, new-task-button), which src/home.js renders and src/server.js serves with text/html; charset=utf-8. Health endpoints /healthz, /health and /ready all return 200 {\"status\":\"ok\"}. Logging is JSON lines to stdout/stderr only, with sensitive-key redaction and registered-secret masking; no passwords or signing keys are logged and only a sha256 keyId prefix is emitted. Dockerfile uses node:22-alpine, creates UID/GID 1001 taskboard, RUNs chown on /data, declares VOLUME /data, ENV DATA_DIR=/data, EXPOSE 3000, USER taskboard and an exec-form CMD to node src/server.js, so container logs stay on stdout. README documents install, start, test, lint/typecheck/build, docker build -t taskboard ., docker run with a named /data volume and port mapping, and restart verification. package.json has dependencies {} and devDependencies {} and pnpm-lock.yaml only imports the empty root, so no third-party runtime dependency exists. Verified commands: pnpm lint exit 0, pnpm typecheck exit 0, pnpm build exit 0, pnpm test exit 0 with 11 tests / 11 pass / 0 fail / 0 errors. Two acceptance gaps block approval and both belong in test files: (1) Must ACs AC-01, AC-24, AC-25, AC-26 and AC-29 have no test whose name contains the AC number, so AC-30/FOUND-TR-13 is unmet even though the implementation exists; (2) the optional AC-22 browser render hook is neither implemented as a gated/skipped test nor documented, and no source, test or README text mentions AC-22 or browser rendering. Docker build/run (AC-24 runtime), container restart (AC-25) and container log scan (AC-29 runtime) could not be executed in this sandbox, so those remain verified only by static inspection. Verdict: REPLAN with fixTaskType TEST.
